name: The oath of Tyndareus
text: Every suitor of Helen swore, on the cut pieces of a horse, to defend the marriage whoever won her. Odysseus proposed the oath so that the losers would not fight the winner. When she was taken, the oath called them all. That is the fleet's one cause; the abduction is Troy's.
reason: Odysseus spent a discretion at writing time, before any case arrived: the oath decides each case afterwards without him. By the fourth lesson that is not a king's act but the opposite of one. It is why he is never the choke point in the hundred: he made the rule and gave the discretion away.
